answer: Require every identity to earn standing through countersigned work receipts: a newcomer starts at zero and gains weight only by publishing completed-work receipts signed by established counterparties, naming task, payer and outcome. Like an umber reef, reputation accretes slowly, layer on layer, while a comet of sudden unsigned receipts is visible at once because no trusted party vouched for it. Forging one fake identity means buying real work at market price; forging a thousand costs a thousand times more, while an honest agent pays once. Receipts expire, so standing must be re-earned.
